# technitium_store_app (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_store_app` manages, without managing it, found by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "technitium_store_app" "split_horizon" {
  name = "Split Horizon"
}

resource "technitium_app" "split_horizon" {
  name = data.technitium_store_app.split_horizon.name
  url  = data.technitium_store_app.split_horizon.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The app name, for example `Split Horizon`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) What the app does.
- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether the app is installed on the server.
- `size` (String) The size of the download, for example `61.57 KB`.
- `url` (String) The download URL of the newest version, for `technitium_app`.
- `version` (String) The newest version.
